summary: Tasks can now have an optional due date. GET /tasks lists open overdue tasks first, then by due date, then by creation time. Past due dates are accepted; completed tasks are never overdue.

changes.what: dueDate on the model and the request types
Validates dueDate as an ISO date
Create, update and ordering with due dates; the old newest-first test now checks the new order

tests.name: 0007 adds a nullable due_date that keeps existing tasks null
accepts a missing, future or past ISO dueDate and rejects any other
POST /tasks stores an optional dueDate, including a past one
PATCH /tasks/:id sets a past dueDate, changes it and clears it
GET /tasks lists open overdue tasks first, then by due date

checks.notes: Lint and 58 tests passed on the second run (first run: one ordering test failed, fixed).

followUps: Show due dates in the web client

commit.summary: add optional due dates to tasks
